description: Show page 1 of one of the user's CVs as an image in its current template — the same view as the editor's free preview. Use after creating or editing a CV, or changing its template, so the user sees the result. Uses one of the daily render slots.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: get_takemeup_cv_preview
title: Preview my CV (image)
